content: The AegisNet Risk Score (0-100) combines real-time accelerometer spectral energy, pulse oximetry trends, and historical risk factors. Scores >75 signal high risk of decompensation or acute event, warranting immediate clinical review.

Physicians can modify prescription routines, update dosage frequencies, and review patient medication adherence directly from the Doctor Dashboard. Automated alerts highlight potential contraindications.

Full longitudinal telemetry logs, including heart rate variability, SpO₂ distributions, and fall incident histories, can be exported as styled Excel health reports (.xlsx) for clinical integration and EHR backup.
Doctors can initiate direct emergency escalation, override automated dispatch triage, and directly contact assigned community responders or hospital dispatch units during active emergencies.
